home.hero_title: Together We Build a Home and a Decent Life
home.hero_subtitle: Help provide a safe and dignified home for a family in need, giving them stability, security, and a better life.
home.trust_desc: We track project progress clearly and update completion with every donation.

houseExperience.eyebrow: A living build — one family, one home
houseExperience.hero_title: Watch Hope Rise, Brick by Brick
houseExperience.hero_subtitle: Help provide a safe and dignified home for a family in need, giving them stability, security, and a better life.
houseExperience.progress_feeling: How close we are to handing over the keys
houseExperience.journey_title: From empty land to a place called home
houseExperience.journey_desc: Every stage you see is a chapter in a family's story — not a spreadsheet, but walls rising, light returning, and life beginning again.
houseExperience.stage_done: This chapter is complete — thank you
houseExperience.story_title: More than walls — a future taking shape
houseExperience.story_p1: Somewhere, a family waits for the day they can close a door behind them and feel safe. Your gift does not disappear into a report — it becomes foundation, roof, garden, and the warm glow in a window at dusk.
houseExperience.story_p2: This is not charity at a distance. It is presence. Every contribution joins hands with others until silence becomes laughter inside a finished home.
houseExperience.story_quote: A home is not only shelter. It is where children sleep without fear, where meals are shared, and where tomorrow feels possible again.
houseExperience.promise_1_desc: Solid structure, secure openings, and a space built to protect — not just for today, but for years to come.
houseExperience.promise_2_desc: When the lights come on, the house stops being a project and starts becoming a refuge for a family.
houseExperience.promise_3_desc: Your gift says: you matter, you belong, you deserve a decent life — and we are building it with you.
houseExperience.closing_eyebrow: The site is alive because of you
houseExperience.closing_title: Add your brick to this home today
houseExperience.closing_desc: Join the build. Leave a mark a family will feel every morning when they wake under their own roof.

moment.base: The ground is prepared. Walls are beginning to rise — and so is hope.
moment.roof: A roof means rain stays outside and worry starts to fade.
moment.openings: Doors and windows turn structure into shelter — a place someone can enter and breathe.
moment.garden: Green returns to the doorstep. Life is planting itself around this home.
moment.lights: Warm light spills from the windows — a sign that someone will live here soon.
moment.interior: The final touches of life are arriving. A family is almost home.
moment.complete: The build is complete. A family can finally call this place theirs.

stage_story.base: Foundations carry more than weight — they carry the promise that this home will stand.
stage_story.roof: Under a secure roof, fear of the elements gives way to rest.
stage_story.openings: Every opening is an invitation: come in, you are welcome here.
stage_story.garden: Trees sway, paths appear, and the outside world becomes part of the home.
stage_story.lights: Even before move-in day, the glow says: someone cares enough to build this.
stage_story.interior: The last details turn construction into belonging.
stage_story.complete: What began as an empty plot is now a address, a refuge, a future.
